NCT07271381.title: THREAT: Testing Harms Related to Exposure to Allergenic and Epithelial Toxins
NCT07271381.sponsor: National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)
primary_outcomes: Cohort 1 (skin): The primary endpoint for the skin substudy is the skin impedance change response from the common environment.

Cohort 2 (GI): The primary endpoint for the GI substudy is analogous to that of the skin substudy, except replacing skin impedance with the Shannon-Weaver diversity index measured on the gut microbiome that measures metabolic diversity.
Cohort 2 (Airway): The primary endpoint for the airway substudy is the airway maximum change response from the common environment minus the airway maximum change response from the pure environment.
Based on combined exposures from all 3 organ systems and randomization design, repeat primary and secondary endpoint responses of Stage 1.

NCT07817836.title: Urban Exposome and Biological Age (IDEA) - impact of air quality and work stress in Pavia on inflammatory cytokines and DNA methylation
NCT07817836.note: Outdoor urban workers (police, taxi drivers, dustmen) vs indoor office controls, personal passive diffusion samplers worn 5 consecutive working days. Primary outcome is blood DNA methylation; secondary is epigenetic-clock biological age; leukocyte telomere length and serum CCL2/CXCL8/CXCL10 among the others. CAVEAT for this watch: the brief summary names PM2.5 among the exposures, but EVERY listed personal-exposure outcome measure is gas-phase or VOC (O3, NO2, SO2, benzene, toluene, ethylbenzene, xylenes, naphthalene, C9 aromatics) -- there is no registered PM2.5 outcome. Treat as an exposome record with no particulate endpoint until the publication says otherwise. analyze_endpoints not run: observational, not a new interventional registration.

NCT07793123.title: Randomized Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Trial Evaluating the Effect of an Oral Antioxidant Dietary Supplement on Skin Radiance in Women Exposed to Urban Air Pollution
NCT07793123.primary_endpoint: Skin radiance by glossymeter, Day 0 to Day 90
secondary_endpoints: Skin radiance (glossymeter D30; clinical scoring D0/30/90)
NCT07793123.note: Third consecutive topical hit whose PM framing no measured variable carries. 'Urban air pollution' is an eligibility descriptor for the enrolled women, not an exposure that is measured, assigned or contrasted: every one of the eight endpoints is a dermatological or biophysical skin measure, there is no PM2.5 or AQI covariate, and the randomisation is on supplement vs placebo, not on exposure. Industry sponsor (Robertet SA, a fragrance and botanical-extract house); n=60, single site, 90 days. Record as an air-pollution-adjacent cosmetic-efficacy trial, not as PM evidence.
